onet_30_3.name: O*NET 30.3 Database
onet_30_3.methodology: O*NET 30.3 Database by the U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration (USDOL/ETA), used under the CC BY 4.0 license. This dataset modifies the original: 8-digit O*NET-SOC specialties are rolled up to 6-digit 2018 SOC codes, skill/knowledge importances are the maximum across constituent specialties, and related-occupation tiers are converted to numeric edge weights. Every qualifying 8-digit specialty occupation (a description plus at least one of own skill ratings, technology skills, or related occupations — no family cap since v3.2.0) is additionally promoted to a first-class entry with its own O*NET description, skills, technology list, and related occupations; each promoted specialty is linked to a wage-parent occupation from which it inherits wage, employment, and projection figures (BLS publishes no specialty-level estimates) — normally its 6-digit parent, or, where OEWS folds the parent into a combined aggregate line (e.g. 29-2010), that aggregate line.
